changes.local: Night sky with bright Orion Nebula cluster in the center amongst the group of stars.
changes.upstream: A shark floats on a net in a containment unit with two people in wet suits nearby. A tracking device is attached to the dorsal fin of the shark.
changes.disposition_reason: Retain existing nebula introduction and higher-resolution Einstein portrait. Shark/GPS introductory replacement and added everyday-technology paragraph are broader editorial changes, previously deferred in relativity review.

changes.local: Special relativity explains why traveling to other star systems, such as these in the Orion Nebula, is unreasonable using our current level of technology. (credit: s58y, Flickr)
changes.upstream: Special relativity has implications and applications ranging from space travel and our understanding of time to everyday technologies such as Global Positioning Systems. In order to be effective, GPS, whether it is a part of a mobile phone or a shark tracking system, must account for relativistic principles such as time dilation. (credit: UW News/Flickr)
